changes_from_535_snapshot: Added three missing eligible six-star operators in Endfield May 14 2026 four-operator special scout. All four labeled featured_banner (special_rerun), not individual rate-up reruns.

Reclassified 52 character records sourced only to WutheringWaves.gg, Zenless.gg, WutheringWaves Fandom and DearPlayers as secondary rather than official. No event dates or existence changed by reclassification.
Automated test added to guard against regressions on special-scout coverage and third-party provenance.

Verified six Wuthering Waves character debut records against Kuro Games pages dated 2024-06-28, 2024-08-15, 2025-06-12, 2025-07-23, 2025-08-28, and the 2025-10-02 maintenance notice; upgraded only these six records from secondary to official.

Reverified four 2024 character debut entries on original publishers' pages: Qingyi/青衣, Yanagi/柳, Shorekeeper, and Camellya. Their original secondary links were replaced with COGNOSPHERE official news and KURO GAMES patch notes.

Replaced third-party sources for launch Jiyan/忌炎, July 22 Changli/長離, and September 7 Xiangli Yao/相里要 with KURO GAMES's own PR TIMES press releases. This brings newly verified entries in this audit batch to seven.
Confirmed 2024-12-12 Yinlin rerun using KURO GAMES official Japanese convene notice /1762.

On 2026-10-12, 35 secondary-sourced Wuthering Waves events were upgraded together to specific KURO GAMES publisher notices, with event-specific evidence in audits/2026-10-12-batch-primary-source-backfill.json.

Added per-record date_basis, explicit limits of official corroboration, and secondary evidence links for all eight outstanding banners; site now publicly renders these in a dedicated provenance backlog.
remaining_gaps: Eight records are still designated secondary because the exact banner event announcement or start time has not been directly verified from the publisher.

Future WW October 22 dates are inferred from the publisher-confirmed phase I end date, not directly announced phase II banner notices. Endfield Tangtang October 29 is from a secondary published schedule.
Thirty-five prior publisher-link upgrades included source content inspected in an independent archive; direct availability of every publisher page remains a separate check.
All 530 officially labeled events have not been individually revalidated in this audit; full history completeness is not certified.
notes: This is a structured local-data audit, not an exhaustive review of every official announcement. Historic earlier audit snapshots must not be treated as current totals.
